subject: NVDA trade #1
original_reasoning: Plan: buy NVDA at the open if ≤ $243 (report, pre-market).
what_happened: The order was not acted on at the open (237.68); it was logged at 15:07 ET at 236.47.
what_missed: No step in the workflow ensured the planned entry was executed or explicitly cancelled at the open.
root_cause: Process gap: entry plans set pre-market had no checkpoint after 9:30.
lesson: Execute or explicitly cancel planned entries at the open, and log the reason for any change. The slightly better price was luck, not skill.
proposed_correction: Add an at-the-open checkpoint to the morning workflow (candidate; needs more occurrences before becoming a rule).

subject: NVDA trade #1
original_reasoning: News/price mismatch: the SpaceX chip financing was not yet priced into NVDA.
what_happened: Same-day headlines on heavy NVDA insider selling and 'the AI rally faces 3 big problems' (Barron's) were in the feed; NVDA fell 1.0% on the reaction day with semis -1.6%.
what_missed: Insider selling and the debt-funded nature of the demand were not weighed explicitly in the report.
root_cause: The report template has no required 'contradictory evidence' field per idea.
lesson: List the strongest contradictory evidence for every ranked idea; the scorecard's 'contradictory' factor now forces this.
proposed_correction: Use the decision scorecard (V1.1) on every serious candidate.

subject: Trading desk automation
original_reasoning: Scheduled runs would produce the Nov 3 pre-market scan, full report and paper entries.
what_happened: Runs started late and froze on permission prompts; an Oct 12 run had blocked the end-of-day review for 3 weeks. No Nov 3 report. TMO's trigger fired at ~693 (10:00 ET) and no paper trade was recorded.
what_missed: No monitoring of whether runs actually finished; NVDA's stop went unrecorded for 25 days.
root_cause: Unattended tasks need permission approvals, and nothing alerts when one stalls.
lesson: Check for each run's output file. Never backfill a missed trade: it gets no credit.
proposed_correction: Run the desk from an attended session until scheduled runs complete reliably.

subject: Screener output
original_reasoning: The scan's top-15 list showed the strongest setups on both sides.
what_happened: Five short setups (CAT, NRG, VST, MP, CEG) were cut because the score favors longs in a bullish regime. Nov 2's report said RDDT was the only bearish setup among those shown.
what_missed: A display cutoff silently removed one side of the market and starved experiment X1 of short signals.
root_cause: Ranking by a long-biased score before truncating.
lesson: Check the full setup list before saying a side has no setups.
proposed_correction: Fixed Nov 4: shorts are always shown and logged. Reporting change only; no trading rule changed.
evidence: Direct inspection of the full screen on Nov 4
